artifact.canonical_name: Copilot cloud-agent reasoning control and comment-triggered automations

sources.title: GitHub Copilot cloud-agent August 3 updates (bound Discovery source)
sources.role: Bound GitHub first-party changelog source record; its bound Raw set includes the August 3 reasoning and comment-automation entries.

claims.text: GitHub says that users delegating a task to Copilot cloud agent can set the reasoning level for models that support the control.

GitHub describes the reasoning level as controlling how much the model reasons before responding, with higher levels potentially using more tokens and credits; the setting is selected with the model when a task starts.
GitHub lists the reasoning-level control as available on paid Copilot plans that include cloud agent: Pro, Pro+, Business, Enterprise, and Max.

GitHub says Copilot cloud-agent automations can be configured to run when an issue comment or pull-request comment is created, with examples including documentation updates, error investigation, and follow-up tasks.
GitHub states that Copilot Business and Enterprise users need the Copilot cloud-agent policy enabled by an administrator for the comment-triggered automation feature.

limitations.text: The bound source covers the August 3 reasoning-level and comment-triggered automation updates only; it does not establish a new model launch or aggregate older June/July cloud-agent functionality.
limitations.context: Temporal and scope boundary stated by the bound changelogs.

limitations.text: Availability, supported models, plans, token/credit effects, and administrator policy are GitHub changelog claims and are not independently tested here.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream use.
